🌐 Publish

Update the public GitHub Pages site

🌐 How to Publish

Follow these steps to update the public site after exporting:

1
Export your data

Click the button below to download godshill_cc_data.json

2
Go to your GitHub repository 🔗 Open github.com/chriswyver/godshill_cc
3
Upload the file

Click Add file → Upload files, drag in godshill_cc_data.json, then click Commit changes

4
Wait ~1 minute then check

Hard refresh with Ctrl+Shift+R if it looks unchanged
